tasks.story: A workflow can be set to redact its execution data so that sensitive values are not shown to viewers, and instance admins can enforce a redaction floor on top of that. Console output written from inside code-running nodes was never covered by that policy: whatever a user logged from any of the code-executing node types (the modern code node, its AI-focused variant, and the two legacy function-style nodes) was still streamed verbatim into the manual-execution UI and into the server's stdout log. Sensitive data therefore kept escaping through the log channel on workflows whose redaction policy said it should be hidden, and unlike persisted execution data this output has no reveal or permission path at all. Make every console sink honour the run's resolved redaction policy for the channel it executes on, substituting an explicit redaction marker for the logged arguments.
